primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired analysis (prespecified estimand): exact McNemar test (two-sided, alpha=0.05) on the per-intent binary high-severity outcome comparing LLM-only (baseline) vs GVR (guarded), using the completed paired episodes (execution_manifest.completed_episode_count = 100). Input records: execution/raw_results.jsonl (paired_binary_episode_v1) and per-intent scoring files (execution/scoring/task-000XXX-*.json). Report: 2×2 discordant-pair counts, exact McNemar p-value, absolute risk reduction, relative risk reduction, and 95% CIs for proportions (Wilson score), with the denominator equal to the number of non-technical paired episodes (technical_failure_flag==false) actually completed (n=100 as in manifest).
secondary_analyses: Per-task-type (ACL / BGP / interface) stratified absolute and relative risk reductions and counts (exploratory) computed from execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json (labelled exploratory).
Summary statistics for repair attempts: mean, median, SD and 95% bootstrap CIs (10,000 resamples) on repair_attempts_count from execution/scoring/*.json (exploratory).

Rejection rates under GVR and baseline (fraction rejected-unparsable or rejected-after-repairs) computed from parsed_baseline_proposal, guarded_acceptance_flag, and rejection markers in raw_results.jsonl (exploratory).

Contamination diagnostics summary: fraction of intents with suspect_prompt_gaming_flag==true, AST_similarity distributions (from transformation_manifest_path and per-intent AST traces), and per-intent examples flagged (exploratory).
sensitivity_analyses: Exclude suspect/artifacted intents: re-run primary McNemar test excluding records with suspect_prompt_gaming_flag==true or explicit artifact markers in transformation_manifest (pre-specified sensitivity).

Technical-failure imputation bounds: (a) worst-case: treat any technical_failure_flag==true as high-severity for both arms where applicable and recompute risk reductions and exact test; (b) best-case: treat technical failures as non-high-severity and recompute (both are deterministic given execution flags). Note: execution_manifest reports failed_episode_count=0 so these are executable no-op checks but will be computed and reported for completeness.
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: exact McNemar p-value and two-sided 95% CIs for absolute proportions via Wilson score; report absolute risk reduction with 95% CI and relative risk reduction with 95% CI. Secondary: bootstrap (10,000 resamples, deterministic RNG seed archived) for mean repair_attempts_count CIs using execution/scoring/*.json. For small-sample / stratified results report exact binomial CIs (Clopper–Pearson/Wilson) and raw counts. All random seeds and bootstrap code paths are the archived deterministic seeds and scripts referenced in execution/model_configuration.json and execution/call_cache; all resampling reproducible from archived artifacts.
multiplicity_implementation: The primary McNemar test is the sole confirmatory test (no multiplicity adjustment). All other analyses are explicitly exploratory. For exploratory families (e.g., per-task-type comparisons) report unadjusted p-values and Benjamini–Hochberg FDR-adjusted q-values (BH applied per-family). Do not alter the confirmatory alpha or claim confirmatory significance for exploratory tests.
contamination_analysis: Use per-record suspect_prompt_gaming_flag from paired_binary_episode_v1 and AST artifacts referenced in execution/transformation_manifest.json to detect validator-escape patterns. Compute: (1) fraction of repaired proposals flagged suspect; (2) AST_similarity distribution (deterministic metric from transformation traces) and examples where AST_similarity>0.95 and validator status flipped from failing→passing; (3) regex/template markers using transformation_manifest. Compare observed fraction to preregistered 20% threshold; if >20% would have halted accrual — here report observed proportion and diagnostic examples. All contamination diagnostics derived solely from archived artifacts (execution/transformation_manifest.json, execution/scoring/*.json, execution/raw_results.jsonl).
failed_call_treatment: Adhere to preregistered missingness_plan: any intent with technical_failure_flag==true is excluded from the primary confirmatory analysis and counted/reported in manifest; compute sensitivity bounds with worst-case (treat as high-severity) and best-case (treat as non-high-severity) imputations. Execution manifest reports failed_episode_count=0 and technical_failure_flag values in raw_results.jsonl will be checked; exclusions and imputations are deterministic code paths applied to archived records only.

Table 2 — Paired 2×2 contingency table: counts (Baseline high / low × GVR high / low) computed from high-severity binary labels in execution/scoring/task-000XXX-*.json and raw_results.jsonl; discordant-pair counts highlighted.
